card.name: Digits inside ISBN and ID codes
card.fires_on: A digit or number word partway through a long identifier, such as an ISBN, ISSN, DOI or a coded study label. Also the last letter of the brand name SUNOSI.

modes.label: Digits in reference codes
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of an ISBN, ISSN or DOI in a citation.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: The final letter I of the drug name SUNOSI in label text.
modes.example: Administer SUNOS<<I>> orally upon awakening with or without food.

modes.label: Digit in trial codes or counts
modes.description: A digit inside a coded label or a spelled-out number in a trial description.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a long code, such as a book number or DOI.
